title: Visual proposals with Luna implementation context

C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Visual proposal standard
phases.goal: Ship one visual-first proposal template with a complete Luna implementation handoff and backward-compatible validation.
phases.exit: The template, skill, checker, documentation and Common Rules 1.12.0 release pass focused and full gates.

items.title: Canonical visual-first proposal template and visual language
items.what: Replace the generic proposal scaffold with a mobile-first visual decision surface and document which visual form answers each kind of proposal question.
items.done: A newly generated proposal is understandable before Decisions, routes authors to the visual language, and remains readable on phones and in dark mode.

asks.quote: So the template should be just visualized, and in the bottom of the template there should be a section for any agent to read to get the deeper details on how everything is handled in a context format. So if I create a proposal using a high-end model, then I can give it to Luna to implement it using the detailed steps below. So you can create a section called Luna, you know, details instructions below, and then Luna can follow it to implement it that way.
asks.note: The visual surface stays concise; a bottom Luna implementation context carries the detailed executable handoff.
